site.name: Last Chance Mine
site.location: Boulder County tungsten district near Nederland
overview: The Last Chance Mine is a documented historic mine in Boulder County's tungsten district near Nederland.
Federal mineral-exploration records identify the Last Chance Lode as a Boulder County tungsten property, while USGS-derived topographic mapping preserves the mine as a named mapped feature.

timeline.text: Federal Defense Minerals Administration records preserved the Last Chance Lode as Boulder County docket 2062, with tungsten listed as the target commodity.

moreHistory: The U.S. Geological Survey's historical exploration-assistance index lists the Last Chance Lode in Boulder County under DMA docket 2062 and identifies tungsten as the commodity.

USGS-derived topographic place data locates the Last Chance Mine at approximately 39.9749869, -105.4997198 on the Tungsten, Colorado quadrangle. Remnant uses that mapped mine-level locality for identification and does not claim that a surviving shaft, adit, or portal has been field-surveyed.

A focused exact-site media search did not locate a reusable Boulder County Last Chance image with clear rights; photographs of same-name mines near Creede and elsewhere were rejected as wrong-site material.
